XMLDB.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS Real-time leaderboards (Tier 2 #7) — Phase L.0 schema. 4 tables: boards (definitions), entries (snapshot rankings), optouts (privacy), events (SSE journal). Tables prefixed local_sentientia_lb_ for global uniqueness. See ADR-014 for the SSE-vs-WS-vs-polling decision.

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_lb_boards
TABLE.COMMENT: A leaderboard definition. One row per leaderboard a trainer or admin creates. Three types: - quiz : top scorers on a single mod_quiz instance - completion : fastest learners to N% complete on a course - skill : most skill points (local_airpay_skills) in a date range Scope: tenant-bound by default. Site admin can promote to customer-wide by setting tenantid=0 (gated on :promoteboard capability). customerid is always pinned at creation from the creator's open_path resolution. Boards cannot move between customers.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Display name shown to learners

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: quiz | completion | skill — gates on per-type feature flag

FIELD.NAME: scope
FIELD.COMMENT: course | tenant | customer — controls who is eligible to appear in this board. course requires courseid > 0; tenant scopes to the board's tenantid; customer requires :promoteboard cap to create.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to course.id for type=quiz or course-scoped completion boards. 0 = not scoped to a course.

FIELD.NAME: quizid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to quiz.id (mod_quiz) for type=quiz boards

FIELD.NAME: skill_ids_json
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of skill IDs for type=skill boards. NULL = all skills

FIELD.NAME: window_start
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix ts — start of the scoring window. NULL = open-ended

FIELD.NAME: window_end
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix ts — end of the scoring window. NULL = open-ended

FIELD.NAME: recompute_seconds
FIELD.COMMENT: Minimum seconds between recomputes for this board. Default 120 (2 min) — matches the cron tick. Min 30.

FIELD.NAME: ownerid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id — who created the board

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS customer scope. Phase 1: hardcoded 1 (Airpay).

FIELD.NAME: tenantid
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS tenant root (1, 77, 177). 0 = customer-wide (requires :promoteboard cap to set).

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: active | disabled | archived

FIELD.NAME: settings_json
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: {top_n: 10, show_my_rank: bool, anonymize_below_rank: int, ...}

FIELD.NAME: last_recomputed
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix ts of the last recompute. 0 = never. Cron checks if now - last_recomputed >= recompute_seconds.

INDEX.NAME: idx_status_tenant
INDEX.COMMENT: List active boards in a tenant (block render hot path)

INDEX.NAME: idx_last_recomputed
INDEX.COMMENT: Cron query: SELECT * WHERE last_recomputed < now - recompute_seconds

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_lb_entries
TABLE.COMMENT: Precomputed ranking snapshot, one row per (board, user). The ranking_engine recomputes wholesale: deletes every row for a boardid, recomputes, inserts. The userrank column uses competition ranking (1, 2, 2, 4) — tied points share a rank, next rank skips. Reads (block + WS) hit this table; never the source aggregation. That keeps the read path O(N) on rows returned, not on the full attempts/completions table.

FIELD.NAME: boardid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_lb_boards.id

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id — the ranked user

FIELD.NAME: points
FIELD.COMMENT: Primary ranking metric. Higher = better. quiz : best quiz attempt grade * 100 completion : -1 * seconds-to-complete (negate so DESC orders fastest-first; UI displays as duration) skill : sum of points earned in window

FIELD.NAME: secondary
FIELD.COMMENT: Secondary metric for UI display: quiz : seconds taken (tiebreak: lower = better) completion : completion-percent * 100 skill : number of skills levelled in window

FIELD.NAME: userrank
FIELD.COMMENT: 1-based rank with competition tie-handling (1, 2, 2, 4)

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: Tenant root pinned at recompute time. Used for tenant scoping on read and for the privacy export.

KEY.NAME: uk_board_user
KEY.COMMENT: One row per user per board — recompute uses delete-then-insert

INDEX.NAME: idx_board_rank
INDEX.COMMENT: Top-N read query (block render hot path)

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_lb_optouts
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-user opt-out from being publicly LISTED on any leaderboard. Opted-out users still accrue points; rankings are still computed (so HR analytics under :viewall can see them); they are filtered out of every audience-facing read path. The opt-out is per-customer (a user joining a different customer would need to opt-out again — different populations, different visibility expectations). Toggleable from /user/preferences.php. Fully reversible via the timeoptedout = 0 path (delete the row).

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id — the user who opted out

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS customer scope

FIELD.NAME: timeoptedout
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix ts when the user opted out. Used for the privacy export to show the user *when* they hid themselves.

KEY.NAME: uk_user_customer
KEY.COMMENT: One opt-out row per user per customer

INDEX.NAME: idx_customer
INDEX.COMMENT: Customer-wide opt-out filter on every read

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_lb_events

FIELD.NAME: boardid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_lb_boards.id

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: Event type name (see TABLE comment for list)

FIELD.NAME: payload_json
FIELD.COMMENT: Type-specific JSON payload

INDEX.NAME: idx_board_id_window
INDEX.COMMENT: SSE poll query: WHERE boardid = ? AND id > ? ORDER BY id ASC. This index is the hot path.
